Agenda:

---

## Fix agent behavior on human PRs

So the fix agent is still firing on PRs that humans open. We talked about
this before — the expectation was that it should only auto-fix stuff opened
by bots or other agents. We've been testing this behavior in the repo that
has those human PR gating scenarios.

Decision: add a label check — if a PR has the `human-authored` label, the
fix agent just skips it entirely. Keeps things simple and avoids those
false positives where the agent rewrites intentional human changes.

Next steps: implement the label gating in the workflow trigger conditions.

## String reversal utility

We looked at the string reversal utility progress. The current implementation
only handles ASCII and we need Unicode grapheme cluster support eventually —
like emoji sequences and combining characters. We discussed three options:

- ICU4C via FFI — too heavy of a dependency for this
- Go's text/unicode/norm package — lighter weight
- Just ship ASCII-only for v1 and iterate from there

Decision: go with ASCII-only for v1. We'll file a follow-up for the Unicode
support. The PR for the basic implementation is ready for review.

## CI pipeline reliability

The CI in the fix agent test environment has been really flaky on
ubuntu-latest. Tests pass fine locally but there's some race condition in
the test harness setup that causes intermittent failures in Actions.

We talked through a few options — retry logic on the test step, increasing
timeouts, or refactoring the harness to do sequential setup. Nobody felt
strongly enough to commit to an approach yet. Needs more investigation to
nail down the root cause.

## Retry logic for transient failures

The fix agent has no retry logic at all right now. If the LLM call times
out or returns a 503, the whole fix attempt just fails silently. We need
at least basic resilience here.

We settled on exponential backoff with 3 retries as the first step. The
circuit breaker pattern was discussed but deferred — overkill for now.

Acceptance criteria we agreed on:
- Only retry on 5xx and timeout errors, not 4xx
- Maximum 3 attempts with exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s)
- Log each retry attempt for observability
- Fail gracefully after exhausting retries
